function norm(s){return String(s||"").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g," ").trim()}
function boot(){
 if(typeof DB==="undefined"){setTimeout(boot,150);return}
 try{if(P.settings){if(P.settings.pay)DB.settings.pay=P.settings.pay;if(P.settings.ref)DB.settings.ref=P.settings.ref;["freeTopics","freeQuestions","freeCbt"].forEach(function(k){if(P.settings[k]!=null)DB.settings[k]=P.settings[k]})}}catch(e){}
 function sb(n){return DB.subjects.find(function(x){return x.name.toLowerCase()===String(n).toLowerCase()})}
 var aT=0,aQ=0;
 (P.topics||[]).forEach(function(tp){var s=sb(tp.s);if(!s)return;
  if(DB.topics.some(function(x){return String(x.subjectId)===String(s.id)&&x.title.toLowerCase()===String(tp.t).toLowerCase()}))return;
  var mx=0;DB.topics.forEach(function(x){if(String(x.subjectId)===String(s.id)&&x.order>mx)mx=x.order});
  DB.topics.push({id:String(++DB.seq),subjectId:String(s.id),title:tp.t,desc:tp.d||"",free:!!tp.f,order:mx+1,active:true});aT++;});
 (P.questions||[]).forEach(function(p){var s=sb(p.s);if(!s)return;
  var t=DB.topics.find(function(x){return String(x.subjectId)===String(s.id)&&x.title.toLowerCase()===String(p.t).toLowerCase()});
  if(!t){var mx=0;DB.topics.forEach(function(x){if(String(x.subjectId)===String(s.id)&&x.order>mx)mx=x.order});
   t={id:String(++DB.seq),subjectId:String(s.id),title:p.t,desc:"",free:true,order:mx+1,active:true};DB.topics.push(t);aT++;}
  if(DB.questions.some(function(x){return norm(x.q)===norm(p.q)}))return;
  DB.questions.push({id:String(++DB.seq),subjectId:String(s.id),topicId:String(t.id),q:p.q,opts:p.o,ans:p.a,exp:p.e,diff:p.d,exam:p.x,year:p.y,free:!!p.f,active:true,status:"approved"});aQ++;});
 saveDB();
 setTimeout(function(){try{toast("\uD83C\uDF0D Seed loaded: +"+aQ+" questions, +"+aT+" topics")}catch(e){}},900);
}
boot();
})();
</script>
